event: European Eternal Weekend 2019 – European Vintage Championship
label: Eternal Weekend Europe

source.label: Eternal Central, European Vintage Champs 2019 coverage

notes.text: The organizer's page (magicbazar.fr/article/221-eternal_weekend_2019_vintage_-_top_8_decklists) now redirects to play-in.com with no content. Eternal Central copied the lists and the playoff bracket from it; placings and seeds come from that bracket. Eternal Central also numbers 3rd-8th, which the bracket does not settle.
Players: 75 per Eternal Central and the organizer's tweet; mtgtop8 says 74, and player tweets say 78 and "80ish".

mtgtop8 has the same eight lists but puts Alex Samaniego in 3rd-4th and Thomas Mar in 5th-8th, which the bracket contradicts (Togores beat Samaniego in the quarterfinals; Mar lost to Younger in the semifinals).
Source prints "Mind'd Desire"; the card is Mind's Desire (mtgtop8 has it right).
mtgtop8 spells him "Tomas Mar"; a player tweet in the source has "Tomáš Már".
